decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk line builds on the firm's core office offer, has its own page, and serves a growing workplace demand, so results likely meet aspirations.
A chair family close to the established offer fits existing capabilities and channels, and the firm is hiring, which signals slack to carry it.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory with uncertain results, but the low resource demand and the link to the rug line let slack carry them.
The sofa is close to the core business, but its mere mention on the website suggests weaker prominence, so a shortfall against aspiration is possible though not evident.
The high standing table complements the conference and office range at low incremental cost and has its own page, so there is no clear shortfall to trigger search.
Although the rug collection is distant from the core, it is presented as a flagship of the firm's direction, and stable conditions with available slack let management tolerate early uncertainty.
